purpose: Validated lead capture form with client-side and server-side validation, consent text, spam protection and submission to the lead API / capture webhook.

configurationFields.description: Field name, label, type, required flag and validation rules
Data-use consent shown above the submit button

permissionsRequired: Public HTTPS endpoint for lead submission

testCases.description: Submit with all required fields valid
testCases.expectedOutcome: HTTP 201 from endpoint; success message shown; lead stored once

testCases.description: Submit with invalid email and empty required field
Bypass client validation and POST an invalid payload directly
testCases.expectedOutcome: HTTP 400 with field errors; nothing stored
All fields reachable and labelled; errors announced

knownLimitations: Contract only: Angular implementation not yet built (Phase B).
rollbackApproach: Point submitEndpoint back to the previous API version or temporarily replace the form with a mailto/phone CTA via config and redeploy.
